input.fit_select_role: clean support bank only; held-out h is excluded from bank; query-time alignment has no labels
input.evaluation_role: support-derived cutpaste/erasure masks and photometric variants only

mechanism.name: cross-image global translation + bandwidth-limited nearest neighbour
mechanism.description: For each query feature map independently estimate one translation to each clean memory image using 16-grid mean-pooled fused features. Drop the lowest 20% overlap cosines and average the normal-majority remainder. At 32-grid query coordinate u, restrict memory coordinates to a Chebyshev radius around u + translation.
mechanism.alignment_score: mean of top 80% per-cell cosine on valid 16-grid overlap
mechanism.shift_tie_break: higher mean cosine, then smaller L1 shift, then lexicographic dy/dx

coordinate_shuffle.scope: one fixed permutation per category/shot/reference-image; features only; each query keeps its own clean-bank shift

methods.global_nn: unrestricted 32-grid NN over all clean bank cells
methods.spatial_bw_nn: query-time translated-coordinate Chebyshev-band NN over clean bank cells
methods.spatial_bw_nn_coord_shuffle: same query-time band rule after fixed per-reference coordinate permutation

metrics.anomaly: Pixel-AP on held-out support-derived cutpaste and local_erasure masks after 32-grid scoring
metrics.normal: cell-level ROC-AUC of clean h versus 15 photometric nuisance variants; 0.5 is stable
metrics.normal_auxiliary: mean nuisance score minus mean clean score
metrics.thin_scratch: excluded from AP because this probe reports only cutpaste and local_erasure as requested

history_audit.t1: same-image 16-grid C1/C2 neighbourhood descriptors; real route archived after negative C1 gate
history_audit.t5: same-image 32-grid relation descriptors; synthetic gain did not generalize to real MPDD
history_audit.v12_prs: normal photometric response axis non-monotonic; archived
history_audit.v12_psmf: image-coordinate multi-shift median approximately smoothing; archived
history_audit.novelty_boundary: cross-image translation and coordinate-constrained matching, not neighbourhood concatenation or image-coordinate aggregation
